videos.caption: 11yr Old Reviews Full Skincare Routine from @Bubble Skincare 🫧  #bubbleskincare #getunreadywithme #skincareroutine #kidfriendly #skinfluencer  If you have a tween who loves skincare but you’re not sure where to start or what’s safe for their skin, then I’d absolutely recommend beginning with Bubble. They have multiple products that are safe for kids under 13, allowing them to begin a healthy & safe skincare routine without any harsh active or anti-aging ingredients that can strip their skin or damage their skin barrier. Each product in this video is kid friendly safe for under 13.  Your child does NOT need all of these products, and truth be told, the best place to start is a 3 step skincare routine: 🧼 Cleanse 🧴Moisturize 😎 Sunscreen This will change as they begin to have hormonal changes in the skin and start to show signs of breakouts, texture, etc and then a usage of a proper toner can be added.  Please remember that we only advocate for safe usage of skincare with parental supervision. Our goal is to help kids explore skincare & makeup with their parents in a way that educates and helps establish a self care routine. We appreciate Bubble for being a strong supporter of this.
